summary: Add RAGflow HTTP MCP server to .mcp.json (Bearer ${RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY}) and point Quality Gates / sync workflows at VPS self-hosted runner labels [self-hosted, Linux, X64] so checks can run despite org GitHub-hosted Actions billing block.

commands.cmd: python3 -c "import json;from pathlib import Path;d=json.loads(Path('.mcp.json').read_text());r=d['mcpServers']['ragflow'];assert r['type']=='http';assert '${RAGFLOW_MCP_API_KEY}' in r['headers']['Authorization'];print('ragflow mcp entry ok')"

python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; g=lambda p:(lambda L: ''.join(L[next((i for i,l in enumerate(L) if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith('#')), len(L)):]))(Path(p).read_text().splitlines(True)); a=g('.github/workflows/gates.yml'); b=g('ci/.github/workflows/gates.yml'); print('gate bodies identical:', a==b); raise SystemExit(0 if a==b else 1)"
